appearance.question: Under Section 9 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, facts not otherwise relevant become relevant when:
options: They are supported by public opinion only
They are recorded in writing
They are inconsistent with any fact in issue or make the existence/non-existence of a fact in issue highly probable or improbable
They are admitted by the accused
appearance.subject: gk
appearance.topic: Paper-IV- Departmental Exam for Sub Inspector under Excise, June-2026.
appearance.canonical_answer_text: They are inconsistent with any fact in issue or make the existence/non-existence of a fact in issue highly probable or improbable

record.question: According to Section 8 of BSA ,2023, when there are reasonable grounds to believe that several persons have conspired to commit an offence, which of the following is relevant against each conspirator?
options: Only acts done after the conspiracy is proved in court
Anything said, done, or written by any conspirator in reference to their common intention while the conspiracy existed
Only confessions made before a Magistrate
Only written communications between conspirators

record.question: In a conspiracy case under Section 8 of BSA, 2023, a letter written by one conspirator describing the conspiracy is relevant against another conspirator:
options: Only if the recipient replied to the letter
Only if all conspirators were aware of the contents
Even if the other conspirator was ignorant of it, provided it was written in reference to the common intention during the existence of the conspiracy
Only if it was written after the conspiracy ended.
